confirmatory.definition: preregistered hypothesis about the core phenomenon, rule fired, direction pre-specified

sensitivity_worst_case.definition: untestable arms as p=1.0 inside confirmatory; survival here means the conclusion does not depend on the exclusion

exploratory.definition: everything else testable; BH is descriptive, survival is not a finding
